#vgamode=9 crtc_start_bytes=0
               COMMUNICATION FROM KRELLAN FLEET HEADQUARTERS                    
               =============================================                    
     To       : Altern RYAN, Battlecruiser IKS FURY                             
     From     : Tribune Kreg, Commander 7th Sector                              
     Subject  : Orders for Reconnaissance Mission into Region #1-A              
     Mission #: 021            PRACTICE MISSION                                 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1. You will take the battlecruiser, IKS FURY, on a Reconnaissance mission      
    into the region of the United Galactic Alliance in front of our sector.     
                                                                                
 2. Your primary objective is to discover at least one mineral-rich planet      
    in UGA or neutral space.                                                    
    INCOMPLETE- no suitable planets discovered                                  
 3. Your battlecruiser will be acting alone on this mission, as few UGA         
    warships are expected. However, supply fleets will be available for         
    your support.                                                               
                                                                                
 4. You have 10 days to complete this mission.                                  
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                         PRESS ANY KEY TO EXIT
